title: What Rectenna Farms Is
definition: Rectenna Farms: farms catching beamed microwave power from space.
description:

title: Real Research Today: Rectenna Farms
definition: Today's documented research behind Rectenna Farms.
description:
The road to Rectenna Farms is already being paved. The US National Ignition Facility achieved fusion ignition (net energy gain) in December 2022. ITER in France is the world's largest fusion experiment, targeting first plasma and Q>10 operation.

Space-based solar power studies (Caltech SSPP, ESA SOLARIS) test beaming power from orbit. Together these programs form the rectenna panels foundation that Rectenna Farms will build on — the farm logistics results, the beam safety methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as farm logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

First commercial farm hulls plant sells rectenna panels power to the grid under a 20-year land use contract.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed rectenna panels demonstrations, farm logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting beam safety uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Rectenna Farms
definition: Estimates Rectenna Farms readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Rectenna Farms components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a farm hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Rectenna Farms operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Rectenna Farms installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 48022 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where rectenna panels monitoring, farm logistics redundancy, or beam safety maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Rectenna Farms Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Rectenna Farms: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Rectenna Farms — farms catching beamed microwave power from space.

Phase 1 — Prove (rectenna panels): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (farm logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (beam safety): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (land use): farm hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and rural land-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
